rewritten_query:
WITH frequent_ss_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1999
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 65 AND 84
      AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, d.d_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 4
),
max_store_sales AS (
    SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk,
               SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_sales_price) AS csales
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 1999
          AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 33
          AND ss.ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk
    ) t
),
target_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 7
),
candidate_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           cs.cs_quantity * cs.cs_list_price AS sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN target_dates d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_item_sk IN (SELECT item_sk FROM frequent_ss_items)
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 33
      AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
           ws.ws_quantity * ws.ws_list_price
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN target_dates d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IN (SELECT item_sk FROM frequent_ss_items)
      AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 33
      AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1987 AND 1993
      AND c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT customer_sk FROM candidate_sales)
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_sales_price) > 0.95 * (SELECT tpcds_cmax FROM max_store_sales)
)
SELECT SUM(cs.sales)
FROM candidate_sales cs
JOIN qualifying_customers qc ON cs.customer_sk = qc.c_customer_sk;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Deferred `best_ss_customer` computation: instead of materializing all ~13k qualifying customers over a full 28.8M-row store_sales scan, first filter catalog/web sales down to the small candidate set (~150 rows by item/date/wholesale filters), then compute the store_sales threshold only for the few candidate bill customers. This is the dominant optimization.

Removed the functionally dependent `substring(i_item_desc,1,30)` from the `frequent_ss_items` GROUP BY (i_item_sk determines the description) and added DISTINCT on item_sk to collapse duplicate rows across dates (IN semantics unaffected).

Removed the redundant `customer` join in `max_store_sales` (grouping by `ss_customer_sk` directly with an IS NOT NULL guard; valid under TPC-DS referential integrity), eliminating hundreds of thousands of customer index lookups.

Introduced `target_dates` CTE to scan date_dim once for July 1999 instead of twice; replaced comma joins with explicit JOINs; reduced `best_ss_customer` output to only `c_customer_sk`; removed the redundant `LIMIT 100` after a single-row aggregate.
